name: Military VS SCPs
desc:
👍 Like the game to support future updates!
⭐ Favorite it so you don’t miss new content.

🔫 Join elite military units sent into a classified SCP facility.
👁️ Face unpredictable anomalies that stalk the halls and hunt without warning.
⚔️ Fight to contain breaches, rescue survivors, and eliminate hostile entities.
📈 Rank up your soldier, unlock better gear, and survive longer with every level.

How long can your squad survive against the SCPs?

🔥 New SCPs, and weapons unlock every 100 Likes.
💥 Deploy now and prove you’re ready for the unknown.
